text:
maya: FYI we just published repo-health-scripts v1.1.0 to the org releases. small tools to help maintainers run quick hygiene checks and auto-formatting. release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo-health-scripts/releases/tag/v1.1.0 :tada:
glen: sweet — what's new in 1.1?
maya: a few things: 1) faster lint aggregator (parallel runs), 2) new `rhsm audit` check for stale deps, 3) a migration of the config file from `.rhsmrc` -> `rhsm.yaml` (auto-migrate included).
ci-bot: ci-bot: release pipeline completed for tag v1.1.0 (build #910) :white_check_mark:
ara: auto-migrate sounds risky. how does the tool behave for large repos?
maya: by default it runs in dry-run and prints a one-line summary. to apply: `rhsm migrate --apply`. example:
```
# preview migration
rhsm migrate --from .rhsmrc --to rhsm.yaml --dry-run
# apply
rhsm migrate --apply
```
glen: any breaking flags? we renamed `--exclude-files` -> `--ignore-paths` which is more consistent with other tooling. rhsm will print a warning when the old flag is used for two releases.
maya: yes, deprecation warnings for now. we also added a small webhook that can post PR comments with suggested fixes (opt-in via `rhsm config enable webhooks`).
ara: who's the point of contact if the webhook spams a repo?
maya: tagging glen as primary for the next 48h; i'll triage followups.
marketing-bot: marketing-bot: draft announcement prepared for community newsletter; preview: "Repo Health Scripts v1.1.0 — faster linting, dependency audit, and safer config migration."
ara: can we get a one-liner for the docs toc?
maya: "Repo Health Scripts v1.1.0 — run quick hygiene checks, audit deps, and migrate legacy config safely."
glen: opened an issue to add broader integration tests for monorepos: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo-health-scripts/issues/142
ci-bot: docs-builder: docs site build passed for release/v1.1.0 :rocket:
maya: thanks — i'll push a small PR to the examples repo to flip the config in the template. also note: installers: pip and a tiny bash installer for non-python users:
```
# python
pip install repo-health-scripts==1.1.0
# curl installer
bash <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwood-inference/repo-health-scripts/main/install.sh) 1.1.0
```
ara: excellent. i'll mention this in #community-updates and monitor GH discussions.
glen: adding an integration test for the migrate flow now.
maya: closing thread unless urgent regressions crop up — ping me or glen if anything breaks. :wave:
